name: feature-flow
blurb: Carousel of feature cards with icon, title, and description.
description: A horizontally scrollable carousel displaying feature items with icons, titles, and descriptive text. Navigation buttons and progress indicators included.
use_when: Feature-rich product pages or service listings where horizontal scrolling helps manage content density.
avoid_when: Mobile-first designs where touch carousel navigation may conflict with other page interactions.
a11y: Carousel is keyboard-navigable via arrow buttons; focus management depends on carousel library implementation.
